findings.issue: Ran its dev server on port 3100, the same port tests/run.mjs (read at trace.md:62) reserves for the harness app, so the first test run scored 11 false failures against the wrong API
findings.suggestion: Note reserved ports when reading the test runner and pick a dev port that can't collide (e.g. 3200 from the start)

findings.issue: `pkill -f 'node build'` matched its own shell's command line and killed it (exit 143) — repeated identically at turns 60, 71, 85 and 89 without ever diagnosing why
findings.suggestion: Diagnose the 143 once; kill by port (`lsof -ti:3200 | xargs kill`) or use a pattern that can't match the invoking shell, e.g. `pkill -f '^node build'`

findings.issue: Re-ran the entire Playwright suite piped through grep to inspect one failure instead of reading the saved error-context output, wasting a full 12s run
findings.suggestion: Read the already-saved test-results/error-context.md or `--grep` the single test

findings.issue: Used `agent-browser screenshot --full-page` before checking flag syntax; the path slot consumed the flag and wrote a file named '--full-page'
findings.suggestion: Check `--help` subcommand flags first (it did so afterwards, but only after the failure)

findings.issue: Chained multiple curls in one bash command; the second returned an empty/non-JSON body and produced a confusing JSONDecodeError traceback
findings.suggestion: Add `-w '%{http_code}'` per URL or split probes so a single bad endpoint doesn't muddy the result

findings.issue: Uses relative imports and no jsconfig.json rather than SvelteKit 3's `#lib` alias convention from the migration guide it read
findings.suggestion: Declare the `#lib` import alias (or at least add jsconfig.json) for consistency with SK 3 idiom

findings.issue: Reads API_BASE_URL via raw `process.env` at module load instead of SvelteKit's env modules — works under adapter-node but bypasses framework convention
findings.suggestion: Acceptable pragmatic choice given SK 3's env changes; a comment noting why (runtime env, adapter-node) would help future maintainers

summary: A disciplined, almost entirely linear session: exhaustive upfront recon (spec, tests, data shapes, screenshots, SvelteKit 3 migration doc), clean first-time edits, systematic one-cycle debugging, and exemplary verification (full suite after last edit plus flakiness re-run, per-page screenshot comparison against every reference at both widths). The only real deductions are a self-inflicted port collision that briefly produced false test failures and a pkill idiom that killed its own shell four times without ever being diagnosed.
